title: 这世上到处都是害怕迈出第一步的孤独之人 #dating #pua

timeline.summary: Mikey asks why people tolerate long-term loneliness, disappointment or inferiority rather than the brief anxiety of approaching someone or challenging the unknown.

He answers that anxiety and fear are brief but intense, while disappointment and inferiority can be prolonged but milder. Dense subtitles confirm the missing predicate in ASR: the brain rejects intense feelings and more readily accepts mild ones.
He concludes that people therefore tend to choose the long but mild emotional cost over short, intense fear.

claims.speaker: Mikey (visual/channel continuity)
claims.statement: He explains avoidance as a choice between brief intense anxiety and a longer but milder state of loneliness, disappointment or inferiority.
claims.conditions: A motivational generalization, not a demonstrated psychological law; people may avoid approaches for many other reasons, including preference, safety, context and respect for others.

claims.speaker: Mikey (visual/channel continuity)
claims.statement: The implied method is to accept a short period of anxiety and take an appropriate first step instead of waiting for fear to disappear.
claims.conditions: Only for safe, lawful, low-pressure actions that do not intrude on another person; rejection or discomfort requires stopping.

speaker_attribution.speaker: Mikey (visual/channel continuity)
speaker_attribution.basis: One on-camera narrator speaks throughout; face and presentation match the channel's formal Mikey talking-head sources. No second speaker appears.

visual_findings: All 12 sampled frames show the same man speaking directly to camera at an outdoor night venue with editorial subtitles.
No approach, recipient, behavioral test or outcome is shown; the visual track does not validate the causal psychology claim.
Ten 2-fps frames from 22.0-27.0 seconds confirm the subtitle '人们的大脑是排斥猛烈的感受', resolving the ASR omission in S00009.

permissions.reason: The usable first-step method is already represented, while the universal brain explanation is unsupported and overgeneralized.

limitations: The automatic transcript was not checked word-for-word against original audio; one omitted word was resolved from embedded subtitles only.
Sparse and targeted dense frames are not continuous audio-visual review.
The video supplies no research, comparison group or observed behavior supporting its brain-level explanation.
Fear, avoidance, loneliness and self-evaluation are compressed into one binary choice and should not be used to diagnose an individual.
